newsitem.title: CYPRUS: SOCCER-CYPRUS V RUSSIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-CYPRUS V RUSSIA WORLD CUP QUALIFIER TEAMS.

Russia - 1-Stanislav Cherchesov, 2-Dmitri Popov, 3-Igor Chugatnov, 4-Iliya Tsymbalar, 5-Omar Tetradze, 6-Valeri Kaprin, 7-Victor Onopko, 8-Andrei Kanchelskis, 9-Alexander Mostovoi, 10-Igor Kolivanov, 11-Igor Simutenkov.
